about_the_game:
The Nuremberg Code is Dead

Rumors describing large-scale unethical human experimentation in the USSR have been circulating for several months, but were recently given confirmation from a Soviet defector, who has exposed the horrible truth of Shadow Project. The Soviet Union has established installations across its territory with the intended purpose of developing humans and animals into machines of war.

Blood Must Spill 

Set in the year 1990, you are part of an American team that is tasked with taking down a series of Soviet military facilities suspected of housing Shadow Project laboratories. Your journey will take you across a range of biomes throughout the former Soviet Union, including dense and lush forests, desolate abandoned villages, and snow capped mountains.

Immersive Gameplay

  • Employ an arsenal of historically accurate weaponry in a wide variety of combat scenarios. 

  • Explore your surroundings with an open level design and terrifying subterranean pathways. 

  • Experience tense encounters with the grotesque creations of the Soviet Union’s new weapons program, while managing a limited amount of supplies and ammunition. 

  • Utilize a weapon attachment system to customize your loadout and gameplay experience. 

  • Modify your gameplay experience with a suite of customization options.

content_descriptors.notes: Shadow Project contains content not appropriate for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600X / Intel Core i5-7600k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X / Intel Core i7-9700k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8GB \ NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER 8GB

short_description: Shadow Project is a narrative-focused, horror FPS that takes place during the fall of the Soviet Union. Immerse yourself in a world of brutal historical fiction, where the events of the late 20th century have taken a dark turn.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Italian
*languages with full audio support
